title: Jericho
lead: An ancient oasis town near the Jordan, the first city Israel took in Canaan. Its fall is the Bible's best-known conquest story and one of archaeology's longest debates (Joshua 6; 1 Kings 16:34; Luke 19:1–10).

sections.b: Moses saw "the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees" from Mount Nebo (Deuteronomy 34:3). Joshua's spies hid with Rahab there, and its walls fell after Israel marched around it seven days (Joshua 2; Joshua 6). Joshua cursed anyone who would rebuild it, and the curse fell on Hiel of Bethel in Ahab's time (Joshua 6:26; 1 Kings 16:34). Elisha healed its spring (2 Kings 2:19–22), which still flows. Herod the Great built a winter palace near it. In the Gospels, Jesus healed blind Bartimaeus near Jericho and stayed with Zacchaeus there (Mark 10:46–52; Luke 19:1–10), and the good Samaritan's road ran from Jerusalem down to Jericho (Luke 10:30).
